decisions.statement: Alan says when the bout is over rather than having that read off his sets.
A run answers the one stretch Alan is on rather than the cool down entire.
No stretch named carries the stretch that follows it.
How far Alan has come is read from the stretches he logged today.
How many stretches and how long each is held are read from the selection policy.

definition: the stretch to hold next, once Alan says the bout is over
